verdict.rationale: Qodo documents its own pre-PR review path: the Agentic Toolbox CLI can "Review changes before opening a pull request", and plugins bring Qodo's review capabilities into coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Kiro. That lets developers catch issues locally before pushing. The evidence frames this as agent/CLI integration rather than a native IDE extension, and does not show that local findings match the PR review. missing for 10: explicit in-IDE extension or editor surface (e.g., VS Code/JetBrains), documented parity between local and PR review findings, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get the same review inside my IDE before I push, catching issues while the code is still in my editor

citations.quote: Review changes before opening a pull request.
The Qodo Agentic Toolbox brings Qodo's code understanding, coding standards, and review capabilities into your existing coding agent.

Use the Qodo Agentic Toolbox CLI when you want to use Qodo-managed skills locally.
